title: Replace ClearLink (CLINK) Controller by Transferring Connections and Mounting New Unit
summary: Safely replace a ClearLink (CLINK) controller by transferring all existing connections from the old controller to the new controller, mounting the new controller in the box/stand using the specified screws, reinstalling side panels, and preparing the operator station to restart.
when_to_use: Use when a ClearLink (CLINK) controller needs replacement and you must transfer the existing wiring connections to the new controller, then remount and secure the controller and side panels before restarting the operator station.
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: performs the physical controller replacement (connection transfer, mounting, panel reinstallation) and initiates the operator station restart handoff.
safety_notes: The source procedure includes a restart handoff to “Starting The Operator Station” (page 66), but does not include lockout/tagout steps in the provided excerpt for this specific installation section.
access_or_tools_needed: Physical access to the ClearLink (CLINK) controller hardware
Tools to fasten M5 socket-head screws and M8 button-head screws (tool type not specified in source)

access_required: Physical access to the CLINK controller hardware
system_preconditions: Old CLINK controller is accessible for connection transfer
New CLINK controller is available and ready to install

steps.title: Identify the old and new ClearLink (CLINK) controllers
steps.purpose: Ensure the correct units are used so connections are transferred to the intended replacement controller.
steps.instruction: Identify the old ClearLink (CLINK) controller to be replaced and the new ClearLink (CLINK) controller to be installed.
steps.expected_result: You have correctly identified both the old CLINK controller (to remove/transfer from) and the new CLINK controller (to receive the transferred connections).
steps.healthy_condition: The old and new controllers are clearly distinguishable and you are prepared to match each cable/connection to the corresponding port on the new unit.
steps.failure_condition: Uncertainty about which controller is old vs. new, or inability to match connection points/ports for the transfer.

actions.label: Confirm controller identities
actions.exact_action: Identify the old ClearLink (CLINK) controller and the new ClearLink (CLINK) controller to be installed.

steps.title: Transfer all connections from the old controller to the new controller
steps.purpose: Preserve the existing wiring by moving each cable to the corresponding port on the replacement controller.
steps.instruction: Transfer all the connections from the old controller to the new controller, matching the connection points/ports so each cable lands on the corresponding port on the new unit.
steps.expected_result: All cables are connected to the new CLINK controller on the corresponding ports (no missing connections).
steps.healthy_condition: Each cable is landed on the matching port on the new controller; connection transfer is complete.
steps.failure_condition: Any connection cannot be transferred to the corresponding port on the new controller.

actions.label: Match and transfer cable connections
actions.exact_action: Transfer all the connections from the old controller to the new controller (match the connection points/ports so each cable lands on the corresponding port on the new unit).

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if any connection cannot be transferred to the corresponding port on the new controller.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “Transfer all the connections from the old controller to the new controller.”

steps.title: Place the new controller in the box and fasten with two (2) M5 socket-head screws
steps.purpose: Secure the controller to the controller box using the specified fasteners.
steps.instruction: Place the new controller in the box and fasten it with the two (2) M5 socket-head screws.
steps.expected_result: The new CLINK controller is secured inside the box using exactly two (2) M5 socket-head screws.
steps.healthy_condition: Controller is seated in the box and the two M5 socket-head screws are installed.
steps.failure_condition: Controller is not secured with the specified two (2) M5 socket-head screws, or the controller cannot be fastened as specified.

actions.exact_action: fasten with the two (2) M5 socket-head screws.

steps.title: Hang the control box on the M8 button-head screws on the stand; route excess cable back into the stand and avoid pinching
steps.purpose: Mount the controller box to the stand while ensuring cable routing is safe and not damaged by pinching.
steps.instruction: Hang the control box on the M8 button-head screws on the stand, ensuring excess cable is fed back into the stand and no wires are pinched.
steps.expected_result: The control box is positioned on the stand using the M8 button-head screws, with excess cable routed back into the stand and no wires pinched.
steps.healthy_condition: Cables are not pinched at the stand/box interface; excess cable is managed inside the stand.
steps.failure_condition: Cables appear pinched, or the control box cannot be positioned with safe cable routing.

actions.label: Mount box and check cable routing
actions.exact_action: Hang the control box on the M8 button-head screws on the stand, ensuring excess cable is fed back into the stand and not pinch any wires.

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if cables appear pinched.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “Hang the control box on the M8 button-head screws on the stand. Make sure to feed excess cable back into the stand and not pinch any wires.”

steps.healthy_condition: No looseness at the controller box mounting points; all four M8 screws are installed and tightened.

success_criteria: New CLINK controller is physically mounted and secured in the box/stand
Connections are transferred to corresponding ports on the new controller
Excess cable is routed back into the stand and no wires are pinched
Controller box is secured with two (2) M5 socket-head screws (controller in box) and four (4) M8 button-head screws (box to stand)
Top and/or bottom side panels are reinstalled as necessary
Operator station restart is performed using the referenced “Starting The Operator Station” procedure
healthy_conditions: All transferred cables are landed on the corresponding ports on the new CLINK controller
No wires are pinched at the stand/box interface
Controller box is secured with the specified M8 button-head screws
Side panels are reinstalled as necessary
failure_conditions: Any connection cannot be transferred to the corresponding port on the new controller
Controller/box cannot be secured with the specified screws
Operator station restart cannot be completed (exact observables not provided in this excerpt)
escalation_guidance: Stop and escalate if any connection cannot be transferred to the corresponding port on the new controller, if cables appear pinched, or if the controller/box cannot be secured with the specified screws.
